title: Her syng Maria kongesongen for flypassasjerane
content:
Artisten Maria Holand Tøsse skulle fly heim til Sunnmøre i dag tidleg for å halde konsert då den triste beskjeden kom om at kong Harald var død. Tanken om at ho burde reise seg opp å synge kongesongen kom umiddelbart.
– Eg ville heidre minnet hans. Kongen var så fargerik og fantastisk, seier Tøsse.
Ho heldt på å miste motet, men fekk støtte av kollega og komikar Terje Sporsem, som lovde å støtte henne. Dermed spurte ho kabinpersonalet om ho kunne få synge, og det vart også klarert med piloten.
Mange gråt
Tøsse gjekk fram og greip mikrofonen, men turte nesten ikkje sjå opp frå teksten.
– Det var veldig sterkt, og eg har følt slik som veldig mange andre no dette døgnet. Det er trist for nasjonen vår, seier artisten.
Mange av dei andre passasjerane filma og fleire gret.
Ein av dei som vart overraska er Erling Omvik. Han er tidlegare redaktør i Fredrikstad blad og var på veg til Ålesund på presseveterantreff. Etter ein halvtimes tid i lufta, i nydeleg ver og utsikt over fjella, høyrde han plutseleg song.
– Det var ein sterk augeblink, og eg fekk klump i halsen, seier Omvik, som aldri har opplevd liknande.
– Musikk er ei kraft
Maria Holand Tøsse vart takka av mange etter det impulsive stuntet sitt. Ho er glad for at ho turte å gjere det.
– Eg trur at musikk er ei kraft som gjer at vi kjem nærare kvarandre som menneske. Og eg veit at kong Harald sette pris på god song og musikk, seier Tøsse.

title: Texas law banning drag shows where children may be present struck down again
content:
A federal judge has, for a second time, struck down a Texas state law banning drag performances in settings where children may be present.
In a ruling issued on Tuesday, US district judge David Hittner said Texas cannot enforce its drag show ban. He said that the measure improperly restricts speech and violates the first amendment of the US constitution.
The Texas ban, known as Senate bill 12, was passed in March 2023 and bans drag performers from dancing suggestively or wearing certain prosthetics on public property or in front of children, or “sexually-oriented performance” presented on the premises in the presence of an individual younger than 18 years of age.
Advocacy groups sued the state after the bill’s passage, arguing the ban on “sexually oriented performance” infringed on constitutional rights. Texas’s move was just one across several states in 2023, driven by a right-wing backlash to increasing queer and transgender rights and equality. Hittner initially declared the ban unconstitutional in September 2023, but it was unblocked by the 5th US circuit court of appeals in 2025, which returned the case to the judge.
That allowed Texas attorney general, Ken Paxton, who is locked in a race for a US Senate seat against Democrat James Talarico, to resume enforcing the law earlier this year.
The new ruling prevents Paxton from enforcing the law. Paxton said he would appeal the decision. “This is a profoundly flawed decision that endangers our children and is an affront to Texas values,” Paxton on X.
In his ruling, Hittner advised anyone “who find such activities as described in this case offensive” to “just don’t go”.
The ruling mentioned Dolly Parton, who died on Tuesday, when it critiqued the law’s definition of banning performances that “appeal to the prurient interest”. Hittner cited people who would chastise Parton “as a voluptuous sex symbol because of her big hair, flamboyant clothes and breast exposure”.
“There are ‘erotic’ elements in countless popular performances that could be subject to both civil and criminal penalties under SB 12,” Hittner wrote.
Hittner said the terms used in the legislation were so broad they could block performers like Lady Gaga or Miley Cyrus from performing in the state.
“Even if S.B. 12 were somehow content-neutral (an argument the Attorney General has never advanced), it still prohibits huge swaths of constitutionally protected performances. Because the term ‘prurient interest in sex’ is open-ended, SB 12 can be used to cherry-pick particular aspects of performances that might be ‘in some sense erotic’,” Hittner wrote.
He said that because the law was very broad it caused some everyday activities, including “cheerleading, dancing, live theater, and other common public occurrences” to be regarded as civil or criminal violations. He also said that the law was vague on its face and that it failed “to give a reasonable person notice of what is prohibited”.
Civil liberties groups welcomed the ruling. “Drag has a rich history as a refuge of joy and liberation for countless Texans, and it’s not going anywhere,” said the Texas chapter of the ACLU in a statement.
“All Texans – no matter our gender or background – are guaranteed the right to free expression,” it added.
Brigitte Bandit, a plaintiff in the case who impersonates Parton, celebrated the ruling on social media. “Drag is free speech, b----.” She announced she would also perform as Parton, who gave her a rhinestone guitar as a gift in 2023, at an Austin bar Saturday in her honor.

title: Liječnici na Šri Lanki muškarcu iz mjehura izvadili kamenac od 3 kilograma
content:
Liječnici na Šri Lanki muškarcu izvadili mokraćni kamenac od 3 kilograma
LIJEČNICI u Šri Lanki uklonili su pacijentu iz mjehura kamenac težak 3,1 kilogram, što je, prema njihovoj procjeni, najveći takav slučaj zabilježen u svijetu. Kirurški zahvat izveden je prošli tjedan u bolnici u gradu Trincomalee na istoku zemlje, piše BBC.
Pedesetpetogodišnji pacijent primljen je u bolnicu zbog moždanog udara. Liječnici su tijekom tretmana uočili da pacijent ima poteškoća s mokrenjem, a daljnje pretrage pokazale su da se u njegovu mjehuru nalazi veliki kamenac.
Tijekom operacije izvađen je kamenac čija težina odgovara težini novorođenčeta, a veličina nojevom jajetu. "Prema dostupnim podacima, ovo je najveći kamenac u mjehuru koji je ikada dokumentiran i kirurški uklonjen", izjavio je za BBC Sinhala dr. Prahalahan Balakrishnan, koji je vodio operacijski tim.
Poput novorođene bebe
Liječnik je dodao da je pacijent sada "vrlo dobrog zdravlja", ali ostaje u bolnici radi nastavka liječenja drugih zdravstvenih problema. Dr. Balakrishnan procjenjuje da se kamenac formirao u razdoblju od pet do deset godina.
Kamenci u mjehuru su čvrste nakupine koje nastaju kristalizacijom minerala iz urina. Najčešće se stvaraju kada se mjehur ne isprazni u potpunosti, zbog čega preostali koncentrirani urin formira kristale. Manji kamenci, veličine zrna pijeska, mogu prirodno izaći iz tijela. Međutim, oni veći od jednog centimetra često blokiraju protok urina i zahtijevaju medicinsku intervenciju. Kamenci veći od četiri centimetra smatraju se iznimno velikima.
Prema Guinnessovoj knjizi rekorda, dosadašnji najveći kamenac izvađen je 2003. godine u Brazilu. Težio je 1,9 kilograma i bio dug 17,9 centimetara. Kamenac koji je prošlog tjedna uklonjen u Šri Lanki dug je oko 17 centimetara, ali je sa svoja 3,1 kilograma znatno teži od prethodnog rekordera.

title: 'Superhero' boy, 9, with amputated foot completes Three Peaks Challenge in under 24 hours
content:
'Superhero' boy, 9, with amputated foot completes Three Peaks Challenge in under 24 hours
- Published
A nine-year-old boy who had his foot amputated as a toddler hopes he has become the youngest amputee to complete the tallest peaks in Wales, Scotland and England in less than 24 hours.
Albie-Junior Thomas finished the Three Peaks Challenge in 22 hours and 30 minutes alongside his dad, powered by ham and cheese sandwiches, sour sweets and four months' training.
The youngster from Hollywell, Flintshire, was born without a fibula in his left leg and his foot was removed at 15 months.
Despite this, at four he became the youngest amputee to scale Yr Wyddfa, also known as Snowdon, Wales' highest peak.
His latest record attempt is yet to be verified.
Self-described "proud dad", Daniel Thomas, told BBC Radio Wales Breakfast: "He's my superhero."
He said: "I've never had anyone to look up to in my life, until Albie."
Daniel said watching his son go through the highs and lows of the challenge demonstrated his "resilience", determination" and "mental strength", which he described as "unbelievable".
Albie-Junior said on each mountain trek he was powered by "ham and cheese sandwiches" cut into squares, "sour sweets for energy" and "lots of fluids".
To get through the physically demanding ascent, he said he would "think of being home with my family or think of doing something really nice", after the challenge was complete.
Having already climbed the tallest peaks in Scotland, England and Wales before, the pair needed to complete all three in less than 24 hours to reach their goal.
Daniel said: "We had already done Yr Wyddfa, at four, Ben Nevis, at five, and Scaffold Pike at, six-years-old, so it was just on to the next. How can we top that?"
"We'll put them all together and tackle the 24-hour Three Peaks Challenge," he added.
Albie-Junior and his dad also aimed to raise funds for their local football club, Holywell Town FC, so far collecting £3,085.
The pair are already looking ahead to embarking on their next challenge, aiming to climb Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania next year.
Asked if he had any nerves or reservations about the prospect of climbing Africa's highest peak, standing at an impressive 5,895 metres, Albie-Junior simply said: "No."

title: A RECKONING: Biko family wants ex-apartheid spy Craig Williamson compelled to testify at reopened inquest
content:
Steve Biko’s family, still seeking truth and answers nearly 49 years after he died in the custody of apartheid security forces, wants former apartheid spy Craig Williamson to appear before the reopened inquest into the anti-apartheid activist’s death.
Williamson infiltrated anti-apartheid organisations while working as a spy for the apartheid government before his cover was blown in 1980. He testified last year at the third inquest into the deaths of the Cradock Four – Fort Calata, Sicelo Mhlauli, Sparrow Mkonto and Matthew Goniwe – where he was questioned about his role in the apartheid security apparatus and his knowledge of anti-apartheid activists.
It was during those proceedings that Williamson testified that he had surveilled Biko.
It is this testimony, together with Williamson’s knowledge of the apartheid security machinery, that prompted the Biko family’s lawyer, Ngqiqo Sakhela, to ask the court on Tuesday for a subpoena compelling him to testify in the reopened inquest into Biko’s death.
The National Prosecuting Authority last September announced that the inquest into Biko’s death had been reopened.
The proceedings were initially expected to get under way on Monday, 24 August, but were delayed due to uncertainty around the Biko family’s legal representation.
The family had applied to Legal Aid SA for funding, but its acting chief executive officer, Ntsumbedzeni Nemasisi, told the court that Biko’s widow, Nontsikelelo “Ntsiki” Biko, did not qualify because her income and the value of her assets exceeded the organisation’s means-test threshold.
Justice and Constitutional Development Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi subsequently approved state funding for the family’s legal representation.
‘Voluminous’ record
Arguing on Tuesday, 25 August for a postponement, Sakhela told the court that the family needed more time to prepare because the legal team had to work through a “voluminous” record running into thousands of pages.
Some of the documents from the original inquest, he said, were in Afrikaans and needed to be translated into English. The translation process would take weeks and cost about R100,000, said Sakhela.
Further complicating preparations, Tembeka Ngcukaitobi SC, who had represented the Biko family pro bono, was appointed as an acting judge of the Constitutional Court. In addition, other lawyers assisting the family had taken on new cases, leaving them short-staffed and needing time to rebuild a legal team for the inquest.
But on Wednesday, 26 August, former KwaZulu-Natal deputy judge president Mjabuliseni Isaac Madondo dismissed the application for a further postponement. He questioned the timing of the application and stressed the importance of getting on with the inquest while witnesses who can still give evidence are available.
Only two of the eight witnesses to the events surrounding Biko’s death are still alive and available to testify, Madondo noted.
He warned that even if the witnesses remained alive following another postponement, their memories could “fade” by the time they eventually testified and that an inquest without witnesses would be “purposeless”, as oral evidence was central to such an inquiry.
Biko, the leader of the Black Consciousness Movement, was arrested alongside fellow activist Peter Jones at a roadblock near Makhanda on 18 August 1977. He had breached a banning order restricting his movement to Qonce (then called King William’s Town). He was taken to the Walmer police station in Gqeberha (then called Port Elizabeth) and detained by members of the Security Branch.
Two surviving former police officers – Daniel Petrus Siebert and Jacobus Johannes Oosthuysen Benecke – have been identified as persons of interest in Biko’s death.
Former Security Branch members from Gqeberha – Siebert, Benecke, Harold Snyman, Rubin Marx and Gideon Johannes Nieuwoudt – sought amnesty at the Truth and Reconciliation Commission in 1997 for their roles in Biko’s death.
Naked and shackled
Biko was allegedly tortured while in custody, shackled and held naked in a cell. Medical attention was only sought after 24 days in custody, when foam was observed around his mouth.
On 11 September 1977, Biko was loaded, unconscious and still naked and shackled, into the back of a police vehicle and transported 1,200km to Pretoria. He died in a cell at Pretoria Central Prison the following day. He was just 30.
His death was attributed to an extensive brain injury and acute kidney failure.
At the original inquest in November 1977, members of the Security Branch who had been involved in Biko’s detention and interrogation claimed that he had sustained his fatal injuries after banging his head against a wall.
Biko’s son Nkosinathi Biko has criticised the handling of the reopened inquest, saying the family was subjected to a process that failed to appreciate the significance of the case.
Speaking to the media after Madondo dismissed the family’s application for a postponement, Biko said he felt compelled to apologise to those who had spent the past two days at court.
‘Gross disrespect’
“For the past two days, you, as well as I, have been subjected to gross disrespect,” he said, pointing out that the court had managed barely four hours of productive time over the two days.
Biko said the family respected the court’s judgment, but believed it had a right to reflect on the decision.
The family had participated in a case-management meeting on Friday, at which it became apparent that the matter was not yet ready to proceed.
“We have one shot at dealing with the inquest of Steve Biko. One shot,” said Biko. “If the toss-up has to be between scheduling and rigour, our preference is that this is done correctly.
“The inquest itself is a possible basis for a prosecution. And because we are dealing with elderly people, we have a diminished chance at prosecution. So the inquest is everything. It’s everything,” he said.
He said the family’s objective was not simply to secure a postponement, but to ensure that the inquest properly examined the circumstances surrounding his father’s death.
“Biko’s right to life was taken. And what we are here to do is to defend his dignity,” he said.
He also questioned the judge’s concern that further delays could affect the memories of the surviving witnesses. Calling that logic troubling, he stressed that the inquest depended on those key witnesses to determine what happened to his father, and that Madondo was effectively creating a defence for them.
Asked whether the family would seek Madondo’s recusal, Nkosinathi said: “We are looking at all options. I can assure you that [recusal] is one of the options.”
The first witness is expected to testify on Thursday, 27 August, when proceedings resume. DM

title: How UAE drivers can remove black points from license with accident-free day campaign
content:
How UAE drivers can remove black points from license with accident-free day campaign
Drivers can register through a link shared by the Ministry of Interior on its official social media account
- PUBLISHED: Mon 17 Aug 2026, 1:32 PM
Registration for the Accident-Free Day campaign opened on Monday, August 17, ahead of its main day on August 31, coinciding with the start of the new school year.
The campaign, organised by the Federal Traffic Council in coordination with police departments across the UAE, encourages drivers to make a commitment to safer road behaviour and avoid traffic violations, while reducing traffic points from their licence.
Here’s what you need to know about registering, taking part and getting the four points removed.
Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels.
How to take part
Drivers can register through a link shared by the Ministry of Interior on its official social media account. Participants can scan the QR code in the campaign’s Instagram post and sign in using UAE Pass.
Once registered, motorists must accept the campaign’s safety commitments, sign the pledge, and agree to its terms and conditions.
A participation certificate will then be sent to the email address associated with the driver’s UAE Pass account.
But registration alone is not enough. Drivers must follow the campaign’s safety requirements and avoid traffic violations.
What do drivers have to commit to?
The initiative focuses on basic road-safety habits that motorists are expected to follow throughout the day.
These include keeping a safe distance from other vehicles, allowing pedestrians to cross safely and wearing seat belts. Drivers must also respect speed limits, avoid using mobile phones while driving, stay in their designated lanes and give way to emergency vehicles.
They are also expected to check that their vehicles are safe and roadworthy before driving. Motorists who fulfil the campaign conditions can have four black points removed from their records.
Why August 31?
The campaign falls on the first day of the new school year, when roads are expected to become busier, particularly near schools and residential communities.
Authorities are encouraging drivers to allow extra time for their journeys, remain patient in congested areas and watch carefully for children, pedestrians and school buses.
The campaign is intended to promote safer habits beyond the single day, encouraging motorists to make responsible driving part of their everyday routine.
What are black points?
Black points are recorded against a driver’s license when certain traffic offenses are committed. More serious violations can result in both fines and black points.
Drivers can accumulate up to 24 black points. If a driver commits another violation after reaching the 24-point threshold, the case may be referred to court, and the driver could face measures including license confiscation or suspension.
The Day Without Accidents initiative offers motorists with existing black points a chance to reduce their total by four, provided they meet the campaign requirements.

title: US's top 3 public university hides freshmen grades to protect students' mental health
content:
Beginning in fall 2027, the policy will apply to incoming students at the College of Literature, Science, and the Arts (LSA), the largest academic division at the University of Michigan which currently enrolls roughly 3,500 freshmen across more than 80 majors.
The university will keep internal records of the grades earned by LSA first-year students during their first semester. These grades may be used for compliance purposes, academic advising, scholarships and awards, as well as applications for internships, majors outside LSA and other academic or professional opportunities.
On their transcripts, however, students will receive only a "P" (pass) or "NC" (no credit) designation for first-semester courses, and these results will not be included in their GPAs.
Starting in the second semester, students' actual grades will be recorded on their transcripts and included in their GPAs for the rest of their time at the University of Michigan, which is ranked third among public schools in the U.S. in 2026 by the U.S. News & World Report.
"We believe that covering grades will help students start strong and curb the mental health crisis unfolding among college-aged individuals," LSA said in its notice.
"Our goal is to help first-year students acclimate to the demands of college and allow intrinsic motivations to guide personally meaningful academic journeys — core elements of a liberal arts and sciences education."
The university said withholding first-semester grades is intended to help freshmen adjust to college life, encourage intrinsic motivation to learn and "foster a culture of connection and collaboration rather than competition."
"They can explore a subject that may not come easily to them or take a course in a new field without the fear that a low grade may have long-term consequences," it said.
The move follows findings from the 2024-25 Healthy Minds Study, which surveyed students at 135 U.S. colleges and universities and found declines in depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts, according to The University Record, the University of Michigan’s official publication.
The study found that 18% of students reported symptoms of severe depression, down from 23% in 2022. The share reporting suicidal thoughts also fell to 11%, from 15% over the same period.
Rosario Ceballo, dean of LSA, said the pilot program could help address high levels of stress, depression and anxiety among students while advancing the college's broader educational mission.
"I believe this pilot program has the potential to not only address the alarming rates of stress, depression and anxiety among our students, but to deliver on our core promise as a liberal arts and sciences college," she told The University Record.
Faculty members have voiced strong support for the policy. Derek Peterson, a professor of history and African studies and former chair of the University of Michigan Faculty Senate, told ABC News that first-year students face substantial life adjustments, including living away from home, working jobs, and managing family and societal pressures.
Peterson noted that the grading buffer allows students to take intellectual risks without severe consequences if they struggle in a challenging course.
"Whatever we can do in terms of policy to enable our students to thrive in a difficult and challenging world that bears on their mental health profoundly, I think that's very much the right thing for us to do," Peterson said.
The policy has also drawn discussion regarding its broader implications for higher education.
Shea Vance, a reporting fellow at The Chronicle of Higher Education, told NPR that some learning specialists worry the shift could reduce student motivation or contribute to grade inflation. Vance noted that the policy reflects an ongoing debate over whether higher education is moving away from traditional grading metrics and toward competency-based assessment.

title: US judge blocks Pentagon bid to blacklist AI firm Anthropic
content:
A US federal judge has ruled that sanctions imposed in February by the Trump administration against AI giant Anthropic were illegal, finding that the government had punished the artificial intelligence company for publicly criticising the Pentagon.
"The empty invocation of national security is not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics," Judge Rita Lin said in a 59-page decision on Thursday.
She barred the federal agencies named in the lawsuit from enforcing President Donald Trump's order to stop using the tools of Anthropic — creator of the Claude AI models — and overturned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's designation of the company as a "supply chain risk," a status previously reserved for foreign firms.
The ruling makes permanent the temporary suspension of sanctions ordered by the judge in March and takes effect immediately. The government may appeal.
"We welcome the court's ruling that this supply chain risk designation was unlawful," an Anthropic spokesperson said on Thursday.
"We remain focused on working productively with the government to harness AI for our national security so all Americans benefit from this technology."
The conflict arose after Anthropic refused to allow the US military to use Claude for fully autonomous lethal weapons or for the mass surveillance of Americans.
Unjust punishment
Trump had lashed out at the company when it took that step. In a February social media post, he called it "a radical left, woke company" and "out-of-control."
In Thursday's ruling, the judge said that the sanctions against the company "were based on a desire to make a public example out of Anthropic for its 'arrogance' in criticising the government" rather than to counter a genuine threat.
The military had been using Claude across a range of classified and sensitive systems. According to reports by the Wall Street Journal and Axios, that included during the January operation that captured Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro.
The supply chain risk designation, formally made in March, had cancelled Anthropic's military contracts and barred other Pentagon contractors from using its technology.
The government said the designation stemmed from Anthropic's refusal to accept contractual terms, not its views on AI safety.
No total victory
However, Anthropic's victory is not total.
A second sanction imposed by the Pentagon on the same day, based on public procurement regulations, remains in effect pending a court ruling in Washington, where a judge refused to suspend the measure in April.
The White House has also bristled at Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's repeated warnings about the dangers of AI — including the impact on jobs.
Anthropic is expected within weeks to make a public stock market listing that could eclipse SpaceX's record Wall Street debut in June, which raised $86.2 billion.

title: Hong Kong unveils its first dedicated psychiatric facility for under-18s
content:
Hong Kong unveils its first dedicated psychiatric facility for under-18s
New site is part of wider redevelopment of city’s main psychiatric hospital to enhance service quality and foster recovery
Hong Kong’s main psychiatric hospital has unveiled the city’s first facility exclusively dedicated to child and adolescent patients, as part of a wider redevelopment that offers upgraded wards designed to enhance service quality and foster recovery.
The redevelopment of Kwai Chung Hospital has increased the total construction floor area from 80,000 to 134,000 square metres, ensuring it can provide 1,000 beds for psychiatric patients.
It also involved the reallocation of specialist outpatient clinics, day hospital facilities and inpatient services to new blocks.
“In psychiatry, the environment itself serves as a form of therapy,” Dr Cheng Koi-man, the hospital’s chief executive, said on Wednesday.
“Compared with the old hospital, this space creates an open, safe and community-like therapeutic environment while offering more indoor and outdoor spaces for inpatients, breaking the public’s stereotype of traditional and enclosed psychiatric management.”
The redeveloped campus includes a new main facility and a child and adolescent block, which is also Hong Kong’s only site dedicated to psychiatric care for patients under 18.

title: V kolínském domě slavného dirigenta Kmocha jsou učebny hudby i školka
content:
Článek
Františka Kmocha připomíná pamětní deska na fasádě. Dům postavený v první polovině 19. století je nyní v majetku města. „Koupili jsme jej od Úřadu pro zastupování státu ve věcech majetkových za 2,8 milionu korun a čekali jsme na vhodnou dotaci, která by přispěla na rekonstrukci,“ uvedl starosta Kolína Michael Kašpar (STAN).
Celkové náklady na rekonstrukci dosáhly nakonec částky 41 milionů korun, z toho dotace zaplatila 25 milionů. „Od 1. září sem budou moci chodit děti. Jsme rádi, že se podařilo zachovat Kmochův odkaz a vznikl i prostor pro hudební školu,“ dodal starosta.
V nejvyšším patře budou tři malé učebny, kde budou žáci základní umělecké školy cvičit na kytaru nebo na flétnu.
První dvě patra budou sloužit školce. „Sídlíme v Kmochově ulici, kde máme třídy pro 48 dětí. Tady v Kmochově domě budeme mít detašované pracoviště, budou tu dětské skupiny pro dvouleté děti,“ řekla Novinkám ředitelka školky Lenka Chybová. „Starší děti máme umístěné, ale byla poptávka po místech pro menší dvouleté děti. Tím se poptávka uspokojí,“ doplnila Lenka Chybová.
František Kmoch se narodil v roce 1848 v obci Zásmuky nedaleko Kolína. V dospělosti se přiženil do Kolína, kde v domě v Kutnohorské ulici žili společně s pěti dcerami. Kolínská městská kapela si ho vybrala za dirigenta a založil tady hudební školu. Kmoch zemřel v roce 1912. Později v 70. letech po jeho rodině a dalších majitelích získal dům stát.
Fungovala tady mateřská škola, pobočka České školní inspekce nebo pedagogicko-psychologická poradna. Od roku 2005 byl dům prázdný a stát ho nabídl k odkupu městu. Na Kolín byl objekt převeden v roce 2016. Jméno a především hudba slavného dirigenta a skladatele, jehož skladby Andulko šafářová, Kolíne, Kolíne či Vraný koně jsou dodnes známé a zní každoročně na festivalu Kmochův Kolín.

title: NT passes voluntary assisted dying laws
content:
NT passes voluntary assisted dying laws
The Northern Territory Parliament passed on Thursday a bill legalising voluntary assisted dying (VAD) in a conscience vote, completing the set for legality throughout Australia.
Several Country Liberal Party backbenchers crossed the floor to vote for changes to their party’s own Rights of the Terminally Ill Bill but ultimately failed to get the numbers, with Cabinet ministers voting as a block despite it being notionally a conscience vote (NTN).
An amendment was tabled to remove the 12-month prognosis time frame for VAD eligibility, but it was ultimately unsuccessful (ABC).
Other unsuccessful amendments included a push to bring the laws in line with expert advice, to remove the doctor gag clause, and to ensure minimum requirements for conscientious objectors (NTN).
The NT is now both the first and last Australian jurisdiction to legislate for VAD after a 1995 law was overturned by the Commonwealth two years later (ABC).

title: Anugerah LJM ketengah inovasi, bakat jurutera Malaysia
content:
Majlis disempurnakan Menteri Kerja Raya Alexander Nanta Linggi itu mengikiraf tokoh, profesional dan organisasi atas sumbangan mereka kepada pembangunan bidang kejuruteraan negara.
Nanta berkata komuniti kejuruteraan memainkan peranan penting dalam pembangunan negara, daripada pembinaan infrastruktur dan bangunan kepada sistem yang digunakan dalam kehidupan harian serta teknologi yang memacu industri.
“Jangan hanya lakukan kerja yang baik, tetapi ceritakan juga kerja baik yang kita lakukan,” katanya sambil menggesa jurutera mengetengahkan kepada masyarakat bagaimana kepakaran mereka memberi manfaat kepada rakyat.
Menurutnya, usaha itu juga penting untuk menarik minat golongan muda terhadap bidang kejuruteraan serta menunjukkan bahawa Malaysia mempunyai tenaga profesional berkualiti yang mampu bersaing di peringkat antarabangsa.
Majlis sempena ulang tahun ke-54 LJM itu menampilkan lima kategori utama anugerah yang merangkumi inovasi generasi muda, kecemerlangan projek, pencapaian antarabangsa serta kepimpinan dan legasi dalam bidang kejuruteraan.
Penasihat Malaysian Resources Corporation Berhad, Judin Abdul Karim, diumumkan sebagai penerima Anugerah Tokoh Kejuruteraan Negara 2026.
Judin berkata beliau berbesar hati menerima pengiktirafan itu, namun menegaskan kejayaan dalam bidang kejuruteraan tidak dicapai secara bersendirian dan memerlukan sokongan serta kekuatan sesebuah pasukan.
Beliau yang mempunyai pengalaman hampir lima dekad dalam bidang itu berkata antara sumbangannya termasuk membantu mendapatkan pengiktirafan antarabangsa terhadap kelayakan jurutera Malaysia menerusi Washington Accord.
Judin juga terbabit dalam penubuhan Mahkamah Pembinaan ketika berkhidmat di Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia (CIDB).
Pasangan kembar Serene Lock Sow Mun dan Irene Lock Sow Mei turut menerima pengiktirafan, masing-masing sebagai Tokoh Muda Kejuruteraan Negara 2026 dan penerima Special Mention International Engineering Award 2026.
“Kami berdua mempunyai visi yang sama, mewujudkan masa depan yang lebih baik untuk generasi akan datang dan kami percaya kerja yang kami lakukan dapat menyumbang kepada itu,” kata mereka.
Dalam kategori baharu BEM Young Engineering Innovation Trophy 2026, Sharvin Christopher Adrian dari Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation (APU) muncul pemenang kategori Ijazah Kejuruteraan.
Pelajar berusia 23 tahun itu membangunkan sistem klasifikasi elektrokardiogram (ECG) bersepadu kecerdasan buatan (AI) menerusi projek tahun akhirnya bagi membantu saringan awal masalah jantung.
LJM turut menyampaikan Penghargaan Khas kepada lapan organisasi media tempatan atas sokongan dalam penyampaian maklumat dan meningkatkan kesedaran masyarakat mengenai bidang kejuruteraan.
Free Malaysia Today antara penerima penghargaan itu yang diterima Ketua Pegawai Operasi Jenn Ngan.
Akreditasi dan pendaftaran jurutera
Sementara itu, Pengarah Jabatan Akreditasi Kejuruteraan LJM Zairul Amri Zakaria mengingatkan pelajar supaya memastikan program pengajian kejuruteraan yang dipilih mendapat akreditasi atau pengiktirafan LJM.
Katanya, pengiktirafan itu diperlukan bagi membolehkan graduan mendaftar sebagai jurutera siswazah selepas menamatkan pengajian, selain memastikan program yang diikuti memenuhi piawaian kualiti ditetapkan.
Ketika ini, kira-kira 288,000 individu berdaftar dengan LJM merangkumi jurutera siswazah, teknologis kejuruteraan dan jurutera profesional.
Pendaftar LJM Megat Zuhairy Megat Tajuddin berkata jumlah itu bersamaan kira-kira seorang jurutera bagi setiap 120 penduduk Malaysia, berbanding sasaran seorang bagi setiap 100 penduduk untuk sebuah negara maju.
Beliau berkata pendaftaran dengan LJM merupakan kewajipan di sisi undang-undang bagi mereka yang mahu menjalankan perkhidmatan kejuruteraan di Malaysia dan perlu diselesaikan sebelum perkhidmatan berkenaan ditawarkan.
Pengarah Eksekutif LJM Mohd Noramil Mohd Daril berkata tindakan boleh diambil terhadap individu yang menjalankan perkhidmatan kejuruteraan tanpa berdaftar, termasuk denda sehingga RM50,000 atau penjara maksimum tiga tahun jika disabitkan kesalahan.
Pendaftaran dengan LJM boleh dibuat secara dalam talian menerusi laman web rasmi lembaga itu dengan bayaran RM50 dan tidak memerlukan pembaharuan.

title: Alta cocina, espuma y economía: la revolución de la cerveza en el mercado peruano
content:
El lenguaje de la sumillería suele asociarse al vino, a las barricas y al romance de la vid. Sin embargo, he aprendido que la verdadera gastronomía peruana no tolera exclusividades; exige diversidad. Hoy, la cerveza en el Perú ha dejado de ser solo el acompañante de las tardes de fútbol para transformarse en un actor relevante de nuestra identidad culinaria y de nuestra matriz macroeconómica.
Para entender este fenómeno que une la tierra, la innovación y el bolsillo de miles de peruanos, conversamos en exclusiva con Raúl Castro, gerente general de la Cámara Cervecera del Perú. Fundada a fines de 2021, esta organización reúne tanto a gigantes globales como a pilares de la identidad artesanal: Backus, Heineken, Candelaria, Sierra Andina, Servus e Invictus coexisten bajo un mismo propósito: la cerveza no es solo una bebida de consumo masivo, sino un ecosistema vivo de alta productividad y valor cultural.
- LEA TAMBIÉN: Backus amplía su apuesta más allá de la cerveza: qué viene con Mike’s, Flying Fish y Guaraná
Desde mi perspectiva como sommelier, observo que la cerveza está ganando un terreno inédito en las mesas de la alta cocina peruana. ¿Cómo define la Cámara Cervecera del Perú el rol actual del producto dentro de la gastronomía nacional?
Creemos que hay un avance por un mix muy claro: tenemos muchos sabores basados en ingredientes peruanos que, precisamente, hacen match con la gastronomía peruana en toda su variedad, sobre todo en el ámbito local. Las más de 280 cervezas artesanales distribuidas en 22 regiones tienen allí un papel fundamental. Pero creo que hay un camino aún largo por recorrer, pues hay que crear nuevas ocasiones de consumo en las que la cerveza se entienda mejor con más platos, más comidas, más momentos. Recordemos que la cerveza es la bebida con el más bajo grado de alcohol de todas. Entonces, ya desde su origen, es una bebida amable para asociarse con comidas y ocasiones de consumo.
Hablando de esa versatilidad en la mesa, el consumidor se ha vuelto más sofisticado y exigente. ¿Cuál es el estado de la innovación en la categoría y cuántas opciones reales tiene hoy un comensal para maridar?
Hay una variedad enorme en el mercado peruano, entonces, hay un alto nivel de competencia, lo que deriva en innovación y sofisticación: cervezas con ingredientes y aromas muy amables al paladar. En una reciente actividad con la Sociedad Nacional de Industrias presentamos maridajes con tapas que incluían quesos y mermeladas, e incluso con comida china, con chifa. De esta forma, rompemos el maridaje natural de cerveza y ceviche y empezamos a entrar a otros terrenos y a otras ocasiones.
Detrás de estos 30 estilos y de la sofisticación del líquido hay un tejido agrícola y humano muy fuerte. ¿Cómo impacta esta cadena de innovación en el desarrollo local y en el campo peruano?
El mayor impacto de la categoría cervecera está precisamente en las localidades donde se produce. Una cervecera, no importa su tamaño, dinamiza a otros sectores, desde el agro, de donde provienen los insumos, pasando por la cadena logística hasta llegar a los puntos de venta como bodegas, restaurantes, bares, hoteles, tiendas de conveniencia, supermercados y hasta el canal virtual. Para que toda esta cadena funcione, todos los eslabones deben cumplir con altos estándares. Todo este proceso incluye las manos de peruanos: agricultores, maestros cerveceros. Y lo mejor es que este impacto económico se queda en el país.
Al analizar el panorama desde la vereda de los negocios, las cifras del sector son contundentes, pero a veces invisibles para el público general. ¿Qué representa la industria cervecera hoy para la macroeconomía del Perú?
Somos el principal aportante del Impuesto Selectivo al Consumo, pagamos más de S/ 5,200 millones en impuestos y representamos el 0.7% del PBI. Sin embargo, hay una alta regulación y una alta tasa impositiva: de cada sol que alguien paga por una cerveza, el 47% se va en impuestos. Es una tasa muy alta, una de las más altas del mundo. Entonces, eso no es un escenario que impulse a la industria, sino que no le permite crecer.
Esa fuerza fiscal se traslada también a la microeconomía de las familias peruanas. Si miramos el canal tradicional, ¿qué peso tiene la cerveza en las economías de los pequeños comercios de barrio?
Aun con este panorama complejo a nivel impositivo, tenemos una industria que emplea de manera directa e indirecta a más de 20 mil peruanos y que, por ejemplo, representa alrededor del 30% de los ingresos de las miles de bodegas que hay en el país. Ahora imaginemos si se fomentara esta industria, si se dieran las condiciones para poder invertir más. El resultado sería mucho mejor.
Salta a la vista una paradoja: somos un país sumamente cervecero en el imaginario, pero los datos muestran otra realidad. ¿Cómo evalúa el consumo per cápita del Perú frente a nuestros vecinos?
Esa es una percepción que creo que todos tenemos, pero cuando miramos la categoría con más detalle, vemos que nuestro consumo per cápita está por debajo de países como Chile, Colombia, Brasil y México. Y esta realidad tiene que ver con las ocasiones de consumo, que no han madurado del todo, por lo que allí surgen nuevas oportunidades.
Ante un consumo per cápita bajo, pero un mercado gastronómico en auge, ¿dónde identifica la Cámara Cervecera las mayores oportunidades para expandir la categoría?
Creo que debemos aprender a incorporarnos decididamente en la gastronomía como un todo, mirar cada mesa, las particularidades de cada región, de cada comida. A partir de allí, entender que construir esa mesa con la cerveza presente en más ocasiones requiere articular con otros actores de manera más decidida: hoteles, restaurantes, bares, para empezar. Y creo que hay un actor que debemos sumar: la academia, las escuelas y facultades de gastronomía. Creo que así podemos construir rutas gastronómicas y asociaciones más potentes.
El gran cierre: una mesa sin límites
La revolución está servida y el paladar peruano, históricamente curioso, exige romper los viejos moldes. Si la vida es un constante viaje de descubrimientos, la mesa en el Perú es su escenario más sagrado. No se trata solo de saciar el apetito, sino de entregarse al placer de experimentar. La cerveza, en su nueva era de madurez y sofisticación, invita a mirar el menú con otros ojos y recuerda que la armonía también puede nacer de la audacia.
Imaginemos, por ejemplo, abrir el apetito con el frescor de una cerveza cuya ligereza y sutil amargor limpian el paladar al encontrarse con la untuosidad y el picante de un tiradito en crema de ají amarillo. O adentrarnos en los secretos de la tradición con una clásica cerveza, compañera de un arroz con pato a la chiclayana, donde el dulzor del cereal abraza las notas del cilantro y la cocina local.
Para quienes buscan el misticismo de los Andes, una densa y aromática Sierra Andina puede acompañar un robusto seco de cordero, logrando que los matices maltosos conversen con los sabores del plato. En la costa, la picardía criolla de un lomo saltado al fuego vivo encuentra su contraparte en el carácter de una Candelaria, que aporta el cuerpo necesario para sostener el ahumado del wok.
Si el viaje nos lleva hacia la precisión y la elegancia técnica, la fineza de una Servus puede desplegarse al lado de un sutil chifa, demostrando que el balance alemán y los sabores nikkei o tusán pueden convivir. Y para coronar la velada con audacia, una potente Invictus puede desafiar los sentidos al maridarse con un postre a base de chocolate amazónico o un clásico suspiro a la limeña, demostrando que la cerveza también puede acompañar los tiempos dulces.
La vida es demasiado corta para beber lo mismo de siempre. Vivir en el Perú es gozar del privilegio de una despensa infinita; limitarse a un solo maridaje sería un pecado de monotonía. Descorchemos, destapemos y atrevámonos a llenar la mesa de nuevas opciones. Al final del día, la felicidad —al igual que una buena cerveza— también se mide por las historias que se comparten en torno a ella.
¡Salud por la nueva mesa peruana!

title: Landesausstellung bringt ganzer Region Touristen
content:
Die Landesaustellung soll für die gesamte Region ein Touristenmagnet sein. Denn sie bringt zahlreiche Besucherinnen und Besucher ins Mostviertel. Die Hoteliers in der Region ließen sich einiges einfallen, um bei ihren Gästen zu punkten. Hotelier Johannes Scheiblauer erzählt: „Gemeinsam mit fünf Kollegen haben wir Lehrpfade in der Streuobstwiese entwickelt. Damit wollen wir unseren Gästen das Naturdenkmal der Region, den Mostbirnbaum, etwas näherbringen.“
Ziel ist es, dass aus Ausflugsgästen Hotelgäste werden. Diese Woche konnte bereits die 100.000 Besucherin der Landesausstellung begrüßt werden. Gastronom und Tourismusvertreter Dominik Hochholzer betont: „Wir wollen die Gäste nach dem Besuch der Landesausstellung zu unseren Betrieben, in unsere Mitgliedsgemeinden bringen. In der LEADER-Region Tourismusverband Moststraße sind 31 Gemeinden, 100 Tourismusbetriebe und regionale Partner.“
Bei einem Lokalaugenschein erzählen die Besucherinnen und Besucher der Landesausstellung, dass sie die Region erkunden wollen. Franz Holztrattner aus Puch bei Hallein (Salzburg) buchte im Mostviertel einen mehrtägigen Wellnessaufenthalt. Erich Lager aus Burgschleinitz-Kühnring (Bezirk Horn) plant noch einen Heurigenbesuch. Regina Hauser aus Steyr (Oberösterreich) will in der Nähe von Mauer Mittagessen.
Malzwelt will als Ausflugsziel punkten
Die Malzwelt in Biberbach (Bezirk Amstetten) ist ein Ausflugsziel unweit der Landesausstellung. Hier gibt es, wie der Name schon sagt, eine Mälzerei. Einblicke gibt es auch, wie Bio-Whiskys und Getreidebrände destilliert werden. Produktionsleiter Josef Farthofer: „Wir wollen das ein bisschen greifbar machen. Mit einem Whisky verbindet man nicht gleich das Mostviertel. Doch ein guter Whisky kann auch vom Mostviertel sein.“
Die Besucherinnen und Besucher der Landesausstellung sollen und wollen auch die regionalen Küchenspezialitäten kennenlernen, etwa im Gasthaus von Evelyn Kappl in Biberbach: „Wir dürfen sehr viele Busgruppen begrüßen und die sind dann auch immer sehr begeistert.“ Die zahlreichen Projekte im Umfeld der Landesausstellung verzeichneten bis jetzt bereits mehr als 200.000 Gäste. Dazu gehört der Tierpark Haag (Bezirk Amstetten) mit seiner Birnerlebniswelt und seinem Indoorspielplatz.

title: Provincie Antwerpen bestrijdt Amerikaanse stierkikkers langs Molse Nete door middel van DNA-stalen
content:
In verschillende vijvers rond de Molse Nete vangt de provincie Antwerpen deze zomer Amerikaanse stierkikkers af, die ze traceert aan de hand van zogenaamde eDNA-stalen. Dat doet ze samen met het Instituut voor Natuur en Bos en PXL Hogeschool. Door die stalen kunnen ze nauwkeurig in kaart brengen waar de stierkikkers zitten en de soort daar afvangen. Zo voorkomen ze dat de soort zich verder verspreidt.
Provincie Antwerpen bestrijdt Amerikaanse stierkikkers langs Molse Nete door middel van DNA-stalen
Samenvatting:
- De provincie Antwerpen vangt deze zomer Amerikaanse stierkikkers af langs de Molse Nete, samen met het INBO en PXL Hogeschool. Via eDNA-onderzoek op waterstalen brengen ze nauwkeurig in kaart waar de invasieve kikkers zich bevinden en zich voortplanten.
- De stierkikker vormt een bedreiging voor de lokale natuur: het dier heeft geen natuurlijke vijanden in België en eet alles van visjes tot eendenkuikens. De aanpak werpt al vruchten af: gevangen exemplaren worden kleiner en soorten als groene kikkers en salamanders keren terug in de vijvers.
- Rond de Molse Nete wil de provincie de soort volledig uitroeien. "Doordat de populatie er niet in verbinding staat met de grote populaties langs de Grote Nete, is de kans groter dat we de verspreiding er volledig kunnen stoppen", zegt Mieke Hoogewijs, experte bij de provincie Antwerpen. Burgers die een stierkikker horen of zien, kunnen dat melden via waarnemingen.be.
De provincie Antwerpen zet deze zomer teams in om de Amerikaanse stierkikker te bestrijden langs de Molse Nete. Via eDNA-onderzoek – dat staat voor environmental DNA – op waterstalen en gerichte afvangsten met fuiken probeert de provincie te voorkomen dat de invasieve kikker zich verder verspreidt.
"De stierkikker is een invasieve exoot", zegt provinciaal Jan De Haes (N-VA). "Hij heeft hier geen natuurlijke vijanden en eet alles wat in zijn bek past: van kleine visjes en insecten tot zelfs eendenkuikens." Als de populatie niet onder controle gehouden wordt, brengt hij schade toe aan de en het van vijvers en beken.
DNA uit de omgeving
De provincie werkt samen met het Instituut voor Natuur en Bos (INBO) met een methode op basis van eDNA. Onderzoeker Reim Brys legt uit wat dat is. "Het komt erop neer dat we op zoek gaan naar DNA-sporen die de kikkers achterlaten in de omgeving."
"Dat doen we door waterstalen te nemen in de vijver. Zo kunnen we zien of er veel stierkikkers in aanwezig zijn, en we kunnen ook zien of het een poel is waar de soort zich voortplant."
Met eDNA-stalen moeten we niet meer zoeken naar een speld in een hooiberg
Reim Brys, onderzoeker INBO
Als er sprake is van voortplanting, is het volgens Brys belangrijk om snel te handelen. "Het is moeilijk om die aparte kikkers overal te gaan vangen, maar het is belangrijk om te weten waar ze aan reproductie doen. Dat is de verspreidingsmotor, dus daar kunnen we de stierkikker het meest efficiënt aanpakken. We moeten dus niet meer zoeken naar een speld in een hooiberg."
De aanpak werpt vruchten af. "De exemplaren die we in Balen afvangen, zijn kleiner dan vroeger, wat erop wijst dat het om jonge dieren gaat. Langs de Grote Nete, waar de bestrijding al langer loopt, worden de gevangen kikkers ook alsmaar kleiner", zegt Mieke Hoogewijs, experte bij Provincie Antwerpen.
"We zien dat het leven in de vijvers zich daar herstelt. In het begin zagen ze geen groene kikkers of salamanders, en die komen daar nu al meer voor", voegt ze nog toe.
Molse Nete als geïsoleerde zone
De Amerikaanse stierkikker is een uitheemse soort uit de VS en Canada, die sinds de jaren 90 voorkomt in de regio. "De populatie is vermoedelijk afkomstig van ontsnapte dieren die ooit verkocht werden op de wekelijkse dierenmarkt in Mol", zegt gedeputeerde Jan De Haes.
Ook op andere plaatsen langs de Grote Nete zijn teams dus druk bezig met de afvangst van de Amerikaanse stierkikker. Aan de Molse Nete is het de bedoeling om de soort volledig uit te roeien. "Het gebied rond de Molse Nete wordt geïsoleerd van de regio Grote Nete, omdat er een kanaal tussen loopt", zegt Hoogewijs.
Doordat de populatie er niet in verbinding staat met de Grote Nete, is de kans groter dat we de verspreiding er volledig kunnen stoppen
Mieke Hoogewijs, experte provincie Antwerpen
Daarom is het volgens haar belangrijk om daar snel te handelen. "Doordat de populatie er niet in verbinding staat met de grote populaties langs de Grote Nete, is de kans groter dat we de verspreiding er volledig kunnen stoppen. Dat maakt snelle ingrepen extra belangrijk."
Burgers kunnen helpen
Er is ook een provinciaal team dat nieuwe meldingen opvolgt. "Burgers die het typische loeiende geluid van een stierkikker horen, kunnen dat melden via waarnemingen.be of rechtstreeks bij de provincie. Die meldingen komen meteen op de kaart terecht", zegt Hoogewijs.
De gevangen kikkers worden via de koelvriesmethode gedood en daarna gebruikt als dierenvoeding. "Ze worden onder meer in dierentuinen gevoerd aan alligators, de natuurlijke vijanden van de stierkikker in Noord-Amerika", legt de experte uit.
Regionaal nieuws uit Antwerpen

title: AIS.chat: Sachsen-Anhalt setzt KI-Chatbot an Schulen ein
content:
AIS.chat: Sachsen-Anhalt setzt KI-Chatbot an Schulen ein
Sachsen-Anhalt stattet seine Schulen mit dem KI-Chatbot AIS.chat – vormals Telli – aus. Der Chatbot soll KI-Kompetenzen vermitteln helfen.
An Sachsen-Anhalts Schulen kann seit Beginn des neuen Schuljahres der KI-Chatbot AIS.chat genutzt werden. Der Chatbot, der vor einigen Monaten noch Telli hieß, wurde bereits in einigen anderen Bundesländern eingeführt. Er soll Lehrkräften und Schülern einen geschützten Zugang zu Künstlicher Intelligenz im Unterricht ermöglichen. AIS.chat ist ein Teilprojekt des Adaptiven Intelligenten Systems (AIS). Das Angebot ergänzt den bereits bestehenden landeseigenen KI-Dienst emuKI.
Bildungsminister Jan Riedel (CDU) betonte anlässlich der Einführung, dass der Chatbot für die Vermittlung von KI-Kompetenzen eingesetzt werden soll. „Unsere Kinder sollen KI nicht nur benutzen können, sondern sie sollen auch verstehen, was sie kann und wo ihre Grenzen liegen“, erklärte er. Dazu gehöre „die Erkenntnis, dass eine überzeugend formulierte Antwort trotzdem falsch sein kann und dass eigenes Denken und Urteilsvermögen durch keine Technik ersetzt werden“.
Entwicklung nach Abstimmung der Länder
AIS.chat wurde im Auftrag der 16 Bundesländer von der FWU gGmbH als Open-Source-Lösung entwickelt. Sowohl die bisherige Auftragsvergabe als auch die Finanzierung – zum Teil aus DigitalPakt-Geldern – sind immer wieder in die Kritik geraten. Das FWU (Institut für Film und Bild in Wissenschaft und Unterricht) setzt das Vorhaben gemeinsam mit technischen Dienstleistern um, während die angebundenen Sprachmodelle nach eigenen Angaben ausschließlich auf Servern innerhalb der EU laufen. Auch werden die bei der Nutzung von AIS.chat anfallenden Daten weder an Dritte weitergegeben noch zum Training der zugrundeliegenden Sprachmodelle verwendet.
Die Anmeldung erfolgt über den bundesweit genutzten Dienst VIDIS beziehungsweise in Sachsen-Anhalt über das Single Sign-on des Bildungsservers. Token-Budgets pro Lehrkraft werden zwischen FWU und den Ländern abgestimmt. Für die Nutzung stehen unter anderem Modelle von OpenAI, Meta und Mistral zur Verfügung. Welche Modelle konkret in Sachsen-Anhalt freigeschaltet sind, hat das Land bislang nicht veröffentlicht – die Bundesländer können individuell festlegen, welche Modelle sie nutzen wollen.
Kompetenzschulung auch für Lehrkräfte
Bevor Lehrkräfte AIS.chat nutzen können, müssen sie selbst erst eine KI-Kompetenzschulung absolvieren. Wer bereits für emuKI freigeschaltet ist, benötigt dem Bildungsserver Sachsen-Anhalt zufolge aber keine erneute Schulung. Lehrkräfte könnten AIS.chat dann beispielsweise einsetzen, um Unterrichtsentwürfe vorzubereiten oder Aufgaben an unterschiedliche Lernniveaus anzupassen.
Videos by heise
Schülerinnen und Schüler benötigen für die Nutzung kein eigenes Konto. Zudem ist die Verwendung eines Klarnamens nicht erforderlich. Lehrkräfte können ihnen für konkrete Unterrichtssituationen einen entsprechenden Zugang zu einem vorbereiteten Lernszenario bereitstellen.
Markenrecht machte aus Telli AIS.chat
AIS.chat löst den früheren Projektnamen „Telli“ ab, der aus markenrechtlichen Gründen seit Mai 2026 nicht mehr verwendet wird. Niedersachsen hatte den Chatbot noch unter dem Namen Telli landesweit eingeführt, Berlin startete im Mai 2026 dann schon offiziell mit AIS.chat. Telli-Vorreiter war das Bundesland Bremen im Sommer 2025.

title: How Morocco’s aerial firefighting system is preparing for the 2026 wildfire season
content:
Canadairs, Turbo Thrush aircraft, Super Puma helicopters, watchmen and firefighters: Morocco is deploying its full range of aerial and human resources to tackle the 2026 wildfire season. The Royal Air Force (FRA) and the Royal Gendarmerie play a central role in the national wildfire response, mobilizing their resources for the mission every year.
The operation is supported by a fleet of eight Canadair aircraft operated by the FRA, along with 15 Turbo Thrush aircraft and two EC225 Super Puma firefighting helicopters operated by the Royal Gendarmerie. This range of aerial resources allows Morocco to adapt its response to the nature and scale of each fire.
Each type of aircraft has a specific role. The Canadairs, deployed for the most critical operations, operate from Kénitra’s 3rd Air Base. They carry out a significant share of aerial firefighting operations, which are conducted according to a four-level national classification that determines the scale of resources deployed based on the severity of a fire.
This classification structures the entire national response. At Level 1, ground crews alone handle the fire. Aerial resources, particularly Canadair aircraft, are deployed from Level 2, when the fire exceeds the capacity of ground teams. Level 3 requires the deployment of Royal Gendarmerie air units to reinforce the resources already engaged. Finally, Level 4 provides for international assistance to be requested when the scale of a fire exceeds national capabilities, in order to protect lives, property and forest resources.
A Canadair takes only about 12 seconds to scoop up water. In a matter of seconds, the aircraft takes on more than 6,000 liters of water before heading directly to the fire to release its load. This speed reduces the aircraft’s turnaround time and allows it to make several runs in a short period, a key factor in containing the spread of flames. The aircraft was designed to operate in difficult conditions. Its technical capabilities allow it to reach mountainous areas and forests that are difficult to access by other means, where ground crews often struggle to advance.
A forest fire spread on Thursday, June 19, in Aïn Lahcen, Tetouan province. Four Canadair firefighting aircraft were deployed to reinforce ground crews. (S.Kadry/Le360)
The Royal Gendarmerie’s Super Puma helicopters are equipped with a modern firefighting system. It consists of a tank mounted beneath the aircraft with a capacity of about 2,500 liters of water or fire retardant. The tank can be refilled in just 20 seconds from a lake, reservoir or any other nearby water source. This ability to refill rapidly close to the fire further reduces downtime between drops.
The Turbo Thrush aircraft complete the aerial response. With a load capacity ranging from 2,000 to 2,500 liters and a flight endurance of about four and a half hours, these aircraft, which specialize in fighting wildfires, can remain over the same fire for extended periods. Their drops are carried out under conditions that balance rapid intervention with safety requirements, two considerations that underpin all aerial firefighting procedures.
This operational readiness cannot be taken for granted. It is supported by preventive and scheduled maintenance carried out outside the wildfire season. The aircraft undergo major inspections lasting several months, including the inspection and overhaul of critical systems such as landing gear, water tanks and engines.
These major inspections are supplemented by daily and periodic maintenance to address the effects of seawater salinity and smoke from fires, both of which accelerate aircraft wear. The entire maintenance system is designed to preserve the fleet’s operational readiness throughout the firefighting season.
The aerial response is only one part of Morocco’s wildfire strategy. The Kingdom is also deploying significant human and technical resources, including more than 2,800 watchmen and forest rangers across the country, tasked with monitoring forests and providing early warnings.
On the ground, a multi-level response
On the ground, the response includes a large number of first-response vehicles operated by the National Agency for Water and Forests (ANEF), alongside Civil Protection trucks and equipment. Specialized units of the Royal Armed Forces, the Royal Gendarmerie, the Auxiliary Forces and local authorities complete the system. All these agencies operate under a unified command and in constant coordination, which is essential to an effective response involving so many different actors.
Civil protection personnel extinguished a fire in the Rahrah Forest in Tangier on July 8, 2026. (S.Kadry/Le360). سعيد قدري
It was in this context of preparations for the 2026 wildfire season, and as part of ongoing efforts to monitor the operational capabilities dedicated to fighting forest fires, that the inspector of the Royal Air Force conducted a working visit to the firefighting squadron at the FRA’s 3rd Air Base on May 20, 2026, according to the latest issue of the FAR Space Review.
The visit began in the maintenance hangar. The general reviewed the technical condition of the aircraft as well as the progress of various maintenance and preparation works. This allowed him to assess the efforts made by technical personnel to ensure that the aircraft would be operationally ready for the upcoming wildfire campaign.
During the visit, technical officials briefed the FRA inspector on the main maintenance operations and ongoing work aimed at ensuring the fleet’s optimal readiness for the upcoming summer campaign. They highlighted measures taken to ensure the aircraft’s airworthiness, enhance their operational reliability and keep the specialized firefighting equipment in working condition.
The general then visited the squadron headquarters, where he attended a briefing on the previous year’s activities, the results achieved during the last wildfire season and preparations for the upcoming campaign. The squadron command highlighted the various measures implemented to strengthen the unit’s operational capabilities.
Particular emphasis was placed on training. Three new captains and four new co-pilots were qualified during this period, strengthening the crews and increasing the squadron’s operational capacity. Expanding the number of qualified personnel directly affects the squadron’s ability to carry out more aerial runs during peak periods of the wildfire season.
Preparations for the 2026 wildfire season also included various training activities. A sea-based training campaign helped crews hone their water-scooping techniques at sea and strengthen their skills under conditions similar to those encountered during actual operations.
Night-flight refresher training was also conducted to maintain and develop pilots’ qualifications in a demanding environment requiring greater mastery of procedures and onboard equipment. Finally, all pilots underwent flight simulator training, allowing them to practice handling various operational and emergency situations in a controlled environment. The training helped reinforce crew responses, improve coordination in the cockpit and maintain a high level of flight safety.

title: Longitudinal changes in depressive symptoms following naturalistic ayahuasca use: A prospective cohort study in Las Vegas, Nevada
content: Ayahuasca use has expanded beyond its traditional Amazonian contexts, yet prospective longitudinal data examining depressive symptoms following naturalistic use in the United States remain limited. We conducted an interim analysis of an ongoing prospective observational cohort of adults participating in naturalistic ayahuasca use in Las Vegas, Nevada. Depressive symptoms were assessed using the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), with higher scores indicating greater depressive symptom severity, at baseline and approximately 48 hours, 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days following exposure. At interim analysis, PHQ-9 data were available for 87 participants at baseline, 61 at 48 hours, 41 at 30 days, 33 at 60 days, and 26 at 90 days. Mean PHQ-9 scores decreased from 8.06 (SD 5.96) at baseline to 4.39 at 48 hours, 3.76 at 30 days, 3.97 at 60 days, and 3.65 at 90 days. Among participants with matched baseline and follow-up assessments, mean changes were -3.58 points at 48 hours, -4.47 at 30 days, -4.48 at 60 days, and -4.76 at 90 days. In a mixed-effects model accounting for repeated observations, PHQ-9 scores remained significantly lower than baseline at 48 hours ({beta}=-3.70; 95% CI -5.09 to -2.31), 30 days ({beta}=-4.34; 95% CI -6.01 to -2.67), 60 days ({beta}=-3.97; 95% CI -5.77 to -2.18), and 90 days ({beta}=-4.25; 95% CI -6.18 to -2.33; all p<0.001). Among participants with baseline PHQ-9 scores [≥]5 and matched follow-up data, 69.2% demonstrated a reduction of at least 5 points at 90 days. These interim findings provide preliminary evidence of a sustained longitudinal association between naturalistic ayahuasca exposure and lower depressive symptom scores through 90 days in a U.S.-based cohort. The observational design, self-selection, incomplete follow-up, and absence of a control group preclude causal inference. Continued longitudinal follow-up is needed to determine the durability of this association.

title: भारत-नेपाल डिजिटल भुक्तानी कनेक्टिभिटी थप विस्तार
content:
काठमाडौं । नेशनल पेमेन्ट्स कर्पोरेशन अफ इन्डिया (एनपीसीआई) को अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय शाखा एनपीसीआई इन्टरनेशनल पेमेन्ट्स लिमिटेड (एनआईपीएल) ले भारत र नेपालबीच सीमापार डिजिटल भुक्तानी प्रणाली विस्तार गर्ने प्रतिबद्धता दोहोर्याएको छ।
भारतबाट नेपाल आउने यात्रुमा यूपीआईमार्फत क्यूआर भुक्तानीको प्रयोग बढेसँगै दुई देशबीच डिजिटल कारोबारको दायरा विस्तार भएको एनआईपीएलले जनाएको छ। हाल भारतको युनिफाइड पेमेन्ट्स इन्टरफेस (यूपीआई) र नेपालको नेशनल पेमेन्ट्स इन्टरफेस (एनपीआई) जोडिएपछि दुवै देशबीच रियल–टाइम ‘पर्सन–टू–पर्सन’ रकम स्थानान्तरणसमेत सम्भव भएको छ।
भारतमा यूपीआईमार्फत मासिक २३ अर्बभन्दा बढी कारोबार हुने गर्छ। अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोष (आईएमएफ) का अनुसार यूपीआई विश्वकै ठूलो रियल–टाइम भुक्तानी प्रणाली हो र विश्वव्यापी रियल–टाइम भुक्तानीको करिब आधा हिस्सा ओगट्छ।
नेपालमा यूपीआईमार्फत मर्चेन्ट क्यूआर भुक्तानी फोनपे नेटवर्कमा आबद्ध व्यवसायीबाट गर्न सकिन्छ। चन्द्रागिरि हिल्स, मनकामना र पशुपतिनाथजस्ता प्रमुख पर्यटकीय तथा धार्मिक गन्तव्यमा समेत यो सुविधा उपलब्ध छ। यसले भारतीय यात्रुलाई नगद बोक्ने वा मुद्रा साट्ने झन्झट घटाएको छ।
सन् २०२५ मा २ लाख ९० हजारभन्दा बढी भारतीय पर्यटक नेपाल आएका थिए। पर्यटन, धार्मिक यात्रा, व्यापार र पारिवारिक आवतजावतका कारण भारतीय पर्यटकका लागि डिजिटल भुक्तानीको बढ्दो पहुँचले नेपाली व्यवसायीलाई समेत ठूलो ग्राहक बजारमा जोड्ने अवसर दिएको छ।
यूपीआई–एनपीआई सम्बन्धमार्फत नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस लिमिटेड (एनसीएचएल) को प्रणालीबाट दुवै देशबीच रियल–टाइम रकम पठाउन सकिन्छ। मोबाइल नम्बर वा भर्चुअल पेमेन्ट एड्रेस (भीपीए) प्रयोग हुने भएकाले बैंक खाता विवरण आदानप्रदान गर्नुपर्ने आवश्यकता पर्दैन।
एनआईपीएलका प्रबन्ध निर्देशक तथा प्रमुख कार्यकारी अधिकृत रितेश शुक्लाले नेपालमा डिजिटल भुक्तानीको पहुँच विस्तार, भारतीय यात्रुको कारोबार सहजता र सीमापार रेमिट्यान्सलाई छिटो तथा किफायती बनाउने दिशामा काम भइरहेको बताए।
एनआईपीएलले नेपालका नियामक निकाय तथा भुक्तानी प्रणालीका साझेदारसँग सहकार्य गर्दै यूपीआईमा आधारित भुक्तानीको पहुँच र पीटूपी रेमिट्यान्स सेवा थप बैंकसम्म विस्तार गर्ने जनाएको छ। कम्पनीका अनुसार यसले भारत–नेपालबीचको डिजिटल तथा आर्थिक सम्बन्धलाई थप बलियो बनाउनेछ।

title: WWF-Brasil financia 50 bolsas para curso de Jornalismo Oceânico
content:
O WWF-Brasil, organização não governamental dedicada à conservação da natureza, financia 50 bolsas de estudo para o curso de Jornalismo Oceânico, uma parceria de ((o))eco e Correio Sabiá. Como parte do projeto 30X30 Brasil: Conectando e Ampliando a Rede de Áreas Marinhas Protegidas, as bolsas são preferencialmente destinadas a jornalistas, estudantes de jornalismo, comunicadores ambientais e profissionais de áreas correlatas que buscam ampliar seus conhecimentos sobre a pauta oceânica.
Para concorrer a uma das bolsas, os interessados devem residir exclusivamente nos estados da Bahia, Ceará, Espírito Santo ou Rio Grande do Norte e preencherem um formulário de candidatura com informações sobre sua trajetória, atuação e interesse na capacitação. As inscrições estarão abertas a partir do dia 24 de agosto.
Leia o edital completo aqui.
Sobre o curso
O curso Jornalismo Oceânico tem o objetivo de ampliar e qualificar a cobertura jornalística sobre a agenda oceânica e é o primeiro do Brasil dedicado exclusivamente à temática. A iniciativa aborda os fundamentos da ciência marinha e os principais temas relacionados aos oceanos, além de técnicas de apuração, uso de bases de dados e ferramentas de investigação por fontes abertas (OSINT), como traduzir linguagem científica, storytelling e estratégias de distribuição e engajamento.
O curso conta com 24 aulas online e assíncronas, além de um encontro ao vivo no dia 02 de setembro de 2026, às 18h30 (horário de Brasília) com Marina Corrêa, Líder da agenda de Oceano do WWF-Brasil, Ana Paula Prates, analista ambiental do Ministério do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima, e Maurício Ferro, fundador do Correio Sabiá e instrutor do curso .
Confira a ementa completa do curso aqui.
“O apoio do WWF-Brasil faz parte da nossa estratégia de trabalhar para que o Brasil cumpra a meta de proteção de 30% do Oceano com a criação e fortalecimento de Áreas Marinhas Protegidas. Dar visibilidade à ciência, à riqueza dos ecossistemas marinhos e aos conhecimentos das comunidades tradicionais aproxima a sociedade do oceano e fortalece a valorização de sua biodiversidade, territórios e modos de vida, diz Marina Corrêa, líder de Oceano do WWF-Brasil.
Bolsas-reportagem
Também oferecidas pelo WWF Brasil, todos os alunos do curso de Jornalismo Oceânico poderão concorrer a cinco (05) bolsas-reportagem. Para participar, é necessário ter concluído o curso e submeter a pauta até o dia 2 de outubro de 2026, em edital específico a ser lançado. Estão aptos a concorrer às bolsas todos os alunos matriculados no curso Jornalismo Oceânico e que tenham concluído o curso até a data prevista.
As pautas terão como tema as três regiões com projetos de conservação dos ecossistemas marinhos e costeiros apoiados pelo WWF-Brasil no processo de criação de áreas protegidas: Abrolhos, Montes Oceânicos e Vitória e Trindade (Colinas Coralinas). Os selecionados contam com mentoria realizada em parceria entre ((o))eco, Correio Sabiá e WWF-Brasil.
“Ao formar olhares atentos dentro das próprias comunidades onde atuamos, criamos um ciclo virtuoso de informação qualificada, transformando repórteres em agentes de mobilização social que falam a linguagem e entendem as realidades daqueles que vivem no entorno dessas áreas marinhas protegidas”, diz Marina.

title: Homecoming for boy 'massive milestone' after transplant
content:
The father of a nine-year-old boy has spoken of his family's "incredible" joy at having their son home in Belfast following a successful heart transplant in the UK earlier this summer.
Dáithí Mac Gabhann was born with rare hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) and had been on the waiting list for a heart transplant since 2018.
He and his family had campaigned for years for a move towards a soft opt-out law and to promote organ donation.
Dáithí's Law came into effect in June 2023.
Máirtín Mac Gabhann told RTÉ's News at One that having Dáithí "fit and healthy enough" to finally be at home was "a massive milestone" in his recovery.
"It's absolutely unbelievable to have Dáithí home in Belfast after eight long years waiting on the gift of a heart transplant."
Mr Mac Gabhann said the first thing his son did "once everything had settled down" was to go on his PlayStation and to talk to his friends.
"I never imagined we would get this far in the journey, so it's very emotional as well to be honest."
Commenting on how well his young son now looks following the heart transplant at the Freeman Hospital in Newcastle, Mr Mac Gabhann said Dáithí's freckles were "always there in the distance behind the blue skin". But now that he has "the colour back in his cheeks, his freckles just came through".
"It's so beautiful to see his beautiful freckles, his beautiful smile with those pink lips. It's just one of those things people might take for granted because people are just used to seeing their kids run about healthy, but these are things we've never seen. Dáithí having warm hands and warm feet and not being out of breath. Those things are unbelievable to us."
The family have posted regular updates on social media showing Dáithí’s recovery, including videos of him playing soccer with his younger brother, and giving a shout-out to actor and retired professional wrestler John Cena, telling him how he never gave up and now has a new heart.
In the latest update, the family are seen returning to Belfast International Airport with a smiling Dáithí walking down the plane’s steps in his beloved Liverpool FC colours.
Mr Mac Gabhann said the family has been "split down the middle" for the last number of weeks, so it was lovely "just to have everyone back together".
He added the "chaos" of having a full house again was "a privilege".
The neighbours and friends who turned out to welcome Dáithí home "they had tears in their eyes, they had seen a different Dáithí, a healthy Dáithí for the first time", he said.
The family and the many well-wishers also joined in a moment of applause for the donor and the donor's family.
"Although we may never know who they are, we want all donor families to know that we are grateful for them."
Dáithí will continue a limited form of isolation for a number of weeks, but is clear to return to school from 1 October.
Mr Mac Gabhann said his son can look to "join a sports team for the first time in his life".
"That's what we are looking forward to most, that normality that he has never had."

title: Funguje dalších šest kilometrů dálnice D35. Tunel Homole se objíždí
content:
Ředitelství silnic a dálnic (ŘSD) otevřelo dalších 6,2 kilometru dálnice D35 mezi Ostrovem a Vysokým Mýtem s výjimkou tunelu Homole, který se objíždí. Do provozu bude uveden příští rok v létě. Jeho otevření zdržely složité geologické podmínky.
Úsek D35 Ostrov – Vysoké Mýto, jehož stavbu zahájilo ŘSD v květnu 2024, navazuje na úsek Časy–Ostrov, který je v provozu od prosince 2022. Od poloviny loňského prosince mohou řidiči využívat také navazující část D35, která slouží jako obchvat Vysokého Mýta. Součástí trasy mezi Ostrovem a Vysokým Mýtem je šest mostů. Náklady dosáhly 1,46 miliardy korun bez DPH.
Silničáři původně plánovali, že celý úsek Ostrov – Vysoké Mýto otevřou v prosinci, a to včetně tunelu Homole. Kvůli komplikacím při ražbě tunelových tubusů však tunel uvedou do provozu až příští rok v létě. Zatím se objíždí po silnici I/17 pomocí provizorních bypassů.
„Tunel Homole komplikovaný je, ale je to výsledek dlouholetých jednání, která vznikala před více než deseti lety během projednávání dokumentace EIA a Zásad územního rozvoje Pardubického kraje. Dostáváme se přímo do kopce, protože jakékoliv trasy, jak jej objet, byly nepřijatelné pro okolní obce,“ řekl generální ředitel ŘSD Radek Mátl. Trasu ale podle něj jinudy vést nešlo.
Silničáři museli při výstavbě brát ohled na životní prostředí, proto se tunel nemohl kopat, ale musel se hloubit ražením, ani nemohla silnice vést v zářezu.
Severní alternativa D1
Díky novému úseku by se mělo ulevit i dopravě ve Vysokém Mýtě. Dálniční obchvat sice již nějakou dobu funguje, nyní však řidiči pojedou po D35 přímo kolem Mýta a nevyplatí se jim městem projíždět.
Od Hradce Králové směrem na východ je z D35 hotový úsek od dálnice D11 k Ostrovu, obchvat Vysokého Mýta a na Svitavsku dálnice mezi Janovem a Opatovcem. Na Moravě je dostavěný celý úsek od Mohelnice na Šumpersku k napojení D35 na D1 u Lipníku nad Bečvou na Přerovsku. Další úseky jsou ve výstavbě. Dálnice D35 spojí Liberec, Hradec Králové a Olomouc a bude severní alternativou přetížené dálnice D1 při cestě z Čech na Moravu.
Koncem letošního roku nebo počátkem příštího by se měl otevřít úsek D35 mezi Džbánovem na Orlickoústecku a Litomyšlí na Svitavsku. Příští rok mají stavbaři dokončit také část Litomyšl–Janov, která vytvoří obchvat Litomyšle. Zbývat budou úseky Opatovec – Staré Město a Staré Město – Mohelnice, které chce nechat stát postavit formou PPP projektů, tedy pomocí partnerství veřejného a soukromého kapitálu. Vše by mělo být hotové v roce 2032.

"We merkten dat er veel overlast was op het Marktplein", vertelt burgemeester Michaël Vannieuwenhuyze (Team Harelbeke). "Jongeren die veel kabaal maakten na 22 uur en mensen uitdaagden. Het is te begrijpen dat mensen samenkomen 's avonds, zeker met die temperaturen, maar na een bepaald uur is het wel de bedoeling dat het wat rustiger wordt. Daarnaast merkten we ook dat er heel wat afval werd achtergelaten."
Daarom besliste de stad om camera's te plaatsen. Er zijn ook regelmatig identiteitscontroles uitgevoerd. "Tijdens mijn verlof ben ik een aantal keer terug in Harelbeke geweest. Van de meeste buurtbewoners krijg ik de melding dat het geholpen heeft. Dat betekent dat we op de goede weg zijn. De maatregelen worden verder opgevolgd."
Extra vuilnisbakken geplaatst
Op het Marktplein zijn er extra vuilnisbakken bijgeplaatst. "Niet alleen jongeren, maar ook andere bezoekers lieten geregeld afval achter, vooral bij mooi weer. Vanaf september gaan we GAS-ambtenaren aanstellen die beter zullen controleren. Zeker in combinatie met de camera's zal dat effect hebben."
